title: PaperDoctor: Evidence-Grounded and Actionable Feedback for Scientific Papers in Progress
abstract: arXiv:2609.16995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoresearch agents are reshaping the research ecosystem, but they can also let flawed claims enter the literature at scale. Human advisors catch such issues in drafts through careful, traceable feedback, yet advisor-style assessment requires extensive manual effort and does not scale. To shift automated paper assessment from a judge to a diagnostician, we introduce PaperDoctor, an agent framework for pre-submission feedback with three key innovations. First, a holistic hierarchical framework evaluates writing, layout, references, code, theory, prior work, and experiments through three layers: L1 surface screening, L2 typed verifiers that route each claim to the appropriate evidence, and L3 reproducers that rerun experiments by priority. Second, each finding contains an observation, a pointer to specific evidence such as a sentence, equation, or code line, and a revision suggestion, making critiques auditable and actionable. translated_title: PaperDoctor：为进行中的科学论文提供有证据支撑且可操作的反馈
translated_abstract: 自动研究智能体正在重塑研究生态系统，但它们也可能让有缺陷的论断大规模进入文献。人类导师能够通过细致、可追溯的反馈在草稿阶段发现这些问题，但导师式的评估需要大量人工投入，难以规模化。为了将自动化论文评估从“裁判”转变为“诊断师”，我们提出了 PaperDoctor——一个面向投稿前反馈的智能体框架，具有三项关键创新。首先，一个整体性的分层框架通过三个层级评估写作、排版、参考文献、代码、理论、相关工作和实验：L1 表面筛查，L2 类型化验证器（将每条论断路由至相应证据），以及 L3 复现器（按优先级重新运行实验）。其次，每项发现都包含一个观察结果、一个指向具体证据（如某句话、公式或代码行）的指针，以及一条修改建议，使评审意见可审计且可操作。第三，Paper……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: PaperDoctor 是一个投稿前反馈智能体框架，通过“表面筛查—证据验证—实验复现”的三层评估体系，为在研论文生成有证据支撑、可审计且可操作的修改建议，将自动论文评估从裁判转变为诊断师。
en_tdlr: PaperDoctor is a pre-submission feedback agent framework that evaluates papers through a three-layer hierarchy (surface screening, typed evidence verifiers, and prioritized experiment reproducers) to produce evidence-grounded, auditable, and actionable revision suggestions, shifting automated paper assessment from judge to diagnostician.
